summary: The exterior of the Meta CorTechs skyscraper is shown. Inside, Rhineheart confronts Neo (Thomas Anderson) about his chronic tardiness and attitude. Rhineheart lectures Neo on company loyalty and authority, giving him an ultimatum: be on time or find another job. Neo accepts the terms. Immediately after, a Federal Express guy delivers a package to Neo's cubicle. Upon opening it, Neo finds a cellular phone that rings instantly. He answers it to the voice of Morpheus, who tells him that 'they' are coming for him and instructs him to stand up and look at the elevator. Neo sees Agent Smith, Agent Brown, Agent Jones, and police officers entering the floor. Morpheus guides Neo via phone to hide in an empty cubicle across the hall. The Agents search Neo's empty cubicle. Morpheus instructs Neo to move to an empty office and open the window. Neo looks out to see a scaffold on the side of the building. Morpheus tells him to use the scaffold to escape to the roof, then hangs up. Neo attempts to climb out the window onto a ledge but is knocked off balance by the wind, dropping his phone. He retreats into the office just as a cop enters.

what_changes.before: Free to leave work, though under pressure
Unaware of the immediate physical threat
what_changes.after: Aware that Agents are coming for him
what_changes.evidence: Morpheus says: 'They're coming for you, Neo [...].'

event_hint.one_line: Agents raid Neo's office and capture him after he fails to escape via scaffold.
